description:
Adele has always been loved by everyone. The praise has been pouring into him suddenly vanished in one day! He suddenly remembers that it could be because of the curse of his family from Hector, a man he once trampled on and kicked away. Adele has no choice but to re-consider the confession of love from Hector again in order to break the curse, "I hope you realize what's the real meaning of true love, otherwise... may you be miserable for the rest of your life'. Will Adele be able to steal Hector's heart?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/6067), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4451002024), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/a_true_ex), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000054692), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/8803), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9110251), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=220753)
